items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 6 June 2026 4:17am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 06 June 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Wet and windy start to the day with a strong east or southeast wind. The rain or drizzle then largely clearing away around lunchtime, as the wind becomes lighter, but staying cloudy with further hill fog patches into the afternoon. Cloud may lift off the hills for a time as it becomes dry late afternoon ahead of further rain later in the evening. Maximum temperature 16°C.

Cloudy tomorrow with outbreaks of rain, more especially in the afternoon/evening with areas of hill fog. Fresh to strong south-southwest wind and a top temperature of 15°C.


##Outlook##

Mainly dry on Monday with sunny intervals, then a few showers later that may merge into a longer spell of rain. Mainly moderate west or southwest wind and a highest temperature of 15°C.
